$comment: Multi-turn chat over contact-search-eval.json's network. Two failure modes are being watched, and they pull against each other: a follow-up that refers back with a pronoun needs the people already under discussion to still be in front of the model (mustNotDrop), while a turn that pivots to a new subject needs retrieval for the NEW question not to be crowded out by the carried ones (mustMention on a pivot turn). A change that helps one and breaks the other is not an improvement.
